notes.title: Underbarrel weapons and new parts - 1
notes.content:
It's a sweet update for those who are tired of just shooting.
Now you can choose and use weapons underneath the barrel.
Like Flamethrowers, grenade launchers, and chainsaws
Other than that, rifle grenade, tactical flashlights, etc
I've added a lot of parts to make cursed gun

A lot of other parts were planned.
Unfortunately, I don't have much time to work.
So I updated what I implemented right away.

And I have an exam for a licensed real estate agent at the end of October.
Maybe no-update season will come again soon.
But, I'll do adjustments or hotfixes when I have some time.

notes.title: Fixed pathfinding bug
notes.content:
A serious bug was reported that the game freezing.

This is due to the game maker's recent update
It was also my problem.
I didn't put the environmental elements in the grid for a couple of reasons
This made the difference between ponchoman and creature where they could go.

It's easy to understand when you think of chess.
ponchoman moves freely, but creature moves in a compartment separated by 12x8 pixels.
If one environmental elements exist halfway across two spaces
ponchoman can go, but creature can't.
This led to an infinite loop of the path algorithm
Eventually, game freezing.

In order to fix this problem, the collision of environmental elements generally revised
and some of them have been re-made.
The map has also changed slightly.

notes.title: Optimization
notes.content:
The hard nut that I've been thinking about for months has finally been solved.
Now the game won't slow down or stutter.

With this optimization, the maximum number of creature is 100.
It's doubled than before.
So it's going to be harder to survive
The trick of being stuck in a corner won't work anymore.

To correct the level of difficulty
Several weapon parts updates are also scheduled.
(Grenade launcher, flamethrower, etc)

notes.title: Key binding
notes.content:
You can now change game's control keys to suit your taste.
You no longer have to whine that the reload key is a mouse wheel.

notes.title: Dash is no longer mouse-oriented.
notes.content:
Instead, do it in the direction of the keyboard (moving direction).
The name was also changed from Dash to Dodge.

notes.title: New creatures
notes.content:
I added 5 new types of creatures to the game.
Each has its own unique ability, just like stock special creatures.
It's expected to be more difficult to survive than before.

notes.title: Font change and HUD improve
notes.content:
I have accepted countless feedbacks that stock font is unreadable.
HUD has also changed a little more intuitively.

And there is other change, the additional round will no longer be inserted during reload.
Instead, by pressing the reload key twice quickly, you can immediately insert it into the chamber.

notes.title: Creature AI improve
notes.content:
Creatures no longer line up in an orderly fashion.
With this patch, the Creatures will try to form a group in a true sense and surround the player.
If a new kind of Creatures is added in the future, it will definitely be harder to survive than before.

notes.title: More and more parts
notes.content:
It's been a really long time.
As previously announced, there has been no update since I was taking the test.
Unfortunately, the test failed by a few questions.

This patch has a number of parts that can change the directional of the rifle.
(Gatling, Quad Barrel, etc.)
Also physical effects of shells and throwbacks,
reload sounds, and compatibility indications between parts
I've finished all sorts of course
Rather than listening to the explanation, I recommend you try it yourself.
There are many experimental parts, so sometimes fatal bugs can occur
I will try to fix it as soon as possible.

notes.title: About the update
notes.content:
I apologize for the lack of recent updates
At the end of October, I have a big test called a real estate agent
I'm so focused on studying that I don't have much time to invest in update
I promise you that there will be frequent updates when it is over,
regardless of whether you pass the exam or not.
Currently, I've implemented low noise, recoil barrel like VSS and multi-barrel like mini-guns.
Besides that, I'm going to add various parts to the next update.

notes.title: More parts and critical chance
notes.content:
bipod, helical magazine and laser sight are added.

You can check the detail in the in-game.
Laser sight is a modified item(gadget) of rifle added with this patch.

Critical chance is the probability of doubling the damage to bullets except pellets
It can be raised with optic and gadget modifications.

This patch is a very small.
In the near future, there will be more parts, creature and convenience patches like key bindings
I am currently studying a random map generation system.
I'll try my best to introduce it into the game

notes.title: Graphic update
notes.content:
The long and long work is over.
Now Ponchoman resolution has been double. 
You can feel a much more detailed description.
This is not the end of the update.
There will be some adjustments in the future and I promise there will be additional content.

The store page image will be modified shortly.

I did really hard work and I think It will bring a big difference in the game.

notes.title: Graphic update status report - 1
notes.content:
The resolution has doubled, so it became more detailed
The Creature is no longer a moving pixel fragments.
This was the first image I had in mind, and I'm satisfied that it came out better than I thought.
The update is still a long way off but I'll get it done as soon as possible.

notes.title: Graphic update in progress
notes.content:
As you know, ponchoman is a low-resolution pixel game.
It's minimalistic. But I feel limited in expression.
So I'm trying to double the resolution.

This work will take as little as a few days
The update will take place within May at the latest.

notes.title: Active item and status system
notes.content:
It's been a really long time since I've updated it.
Ponchoman can now use something called an active item.
Active item has only very basic things like throw-in, medicine, and I'm going to add items later.

And from now on, what you get from the Choose system is no longer replaced by the current state.
Which means that once you choose, you'll never reappear in the Choose system again
The Tab key opens the Status to allow for replacement as if it were an inventory.
I've tried, but I recommend that you refrain from using it
if there are problems because bugs or unintended things may occur.
But I'll solve it quickly.

notes.title: About future updates
notes.content:
Many say that game content is consumed too quickly.
I'm also aware of that and I'm trying to improve it.
Ponchoman has a lot of updates coming up.
I'd like to share a few things with you now.

First of all, I'm currently introducing an active item.
Active items can be used as throwing weapons,
such as frag grenade, flash bang and molotov.
It can also be auxiliary equipment,
such as adrenaline syringes and first aid kits.

And the bullets and parts chosen by the choose system...
It's no longer a replacement method, it's added to the inventory.
I'm trying to make sure the player can press tab at any time to replace it.

I also want to add key settings for players
who are experiencing a lot of inconvenience due to key placement.

And this is something I'm still thinking about,
I'm trying to fix the basic game system to reduce the repetitive and boring feeling.
For example, new maps and mobs.

In addition, I'm planning to add more attachments
and other improvements to add content as soon as I can think of it.

notes.title: Choose UI improvement
notes.content:
Since its launch, it has received many reviews for its poor explanation of choose.
So I've made a big improvement in the UI,
allowing players to know exactly what the results are based on their choices.

notes.title: New ammo type 'caliber'
notes.content:
With this patch, ammo type caliber has been added.
The existing ammo type was gauge.
If it was like a shotgun,
Caliber is close to a rifle.
Adding caliber does not mean removing gauge.
When you start the game, you will choose either caliber or gauge randomly.

Related patch
Semi-auto and full-auto have their own advantages.
The semi-auto does not spread out and can be launched faster than the full auto
if rifle is modified mainly for recoil control.
Full-auto has a spread, but it can be reduced rifle is modified mainly for recoil control
and provides fast fire speed.

notes.title: About the update log
notes.content:
I apologize for not posting an update log every time I update.
This game is my first work and there are a lot of issues to solve.
Since its release, it has been patched almost in real time.
So it's hard to write them down every single time.
I fully understand your confusion about this.

I changed the way the version is written.
ex) 1.06 > 220320 (date)
For large-scale patches that significantly add content to the game,
I decided to post an update log.
Once again, I really apologize for the lack of game development and management.
